jurisdiction.venue: SEBI, SAT, NCLT, Enforcement Directorate (ED) & SFIO

headline: Borrowed for Electric Cabs, Parked in Gurugram’s Most Exclusive Driveway, SEBI Says
deck: SEBI banned Gensol and BluSmart promoters Anmol and Puneet Jaggi, alleging ₹42.94 crore of state EV loans was routed toward a luxury condo.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: Market and director bans confirmed July 30, 2025; insolvency and criminal ED/SFIO probes remain active over diverted state EV loans.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: If proven, the diversion SEBI alleges would resemble taking a ₹1.5 lakh auto-rickshaw loan and spending it on luxury jewelry
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Immediate bank repossession and local criminal breach-of-trust FIR

sources.title: SEBI Confirmatory Order in the Matter of Gensol Engineering Ltd. and Promoters Anmol & Puneet Jaggi
sources.agency: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

interactive_art_spec.caption: D.L.F. luxury towers in Gurugram. SEBI alleges ₹42.94 crore in public electric-vehicle loans was routed toward a DLF The Camellias apartment.
